steps: DROP down onto your hands and knees.
COVER your head and neck with your arms. If a sturdy table is nearby, crawl under it.
HOLD ON to your shelter until shaking stops. If no shelter, stay against an interior wall.
STAY AWAY from glass, windows, outside doors and walls, and anything that could fall.
Check yourself and others for injuries.
Check for gas leaks. If you smell gas, turn off the main gas valve.
Expect aftershocks. These are often less intense but can cause additional damage.
Use the Mesh Chat to report your status to others nearby.
Listen to emergency broadcasts if possible.
Keep the app open and mesh active to help relay messages for others.
Battery low? Switch to 'Power Save' in settings (coming soon) or disable non-essential tools.
Hotspot Relay mode allows devices that can't see each other to connect through you.
PTT (Push-to-Talk) is best for quick status checks without typing.
Apply direct pressure to the wound with a clean cloth.
If bleeding is severe and on a limb, consider a tourniquet if trained.
